The subject features numerous upright, cylindrical branches in shades of pale orange and cream, rising from an unseen base. The tips are bifurcated or rounded. A thin, dark, out-of-focus twig or pine needle crosses the foreground on the right side. The background is a soft, blurred green and brown bokeh, indicating a forest floor environment.
